_comment: Per-project harness config. Copy to your project root as hydra-agents.json and edit. All paths are relative to the project root (checked in, portable). This example carries Hydra's own values.
_sessionPrefix_comment: Optional. Machine-global prefix for tmux session / agent names, so two projects on one host don't collide on `staging` / `feature_NNN_*`. Defaults to the repo name from issueRepo + '-' (here: 'hydra-'). Override only if the repo name is awkward. Branch/worktree names stay unprefixed.
